answer_2.quote: We examine if the models can recover masked-out keywords in the statement given the remaining context... We also evaluate if PTLMs assign higher probability for statements that express commonsense axioms versus contradictory statements... The average binary accuracies of all five models ... are around 0.5...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) on 10k of our collected 257k statements... We present a pair of statements ... and ask two annotators to choose the one that follows commonsense.
answer_4.guideline: Present two variant statements (original vs. flipped comparative) and ask annotators to select which statement follows commonsense; majority voting is used for validation.
